The '''Tumris clan''' was, along with the [[Helshar clan]], one of the two clans found in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Quolas]]. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the two clans were bitter rivals and dominated the city.<ref name="CotG" />

Eventually, [[Gel Marcolf]] took over Quolas, which reduced the power of the clans.<ref name="CotG" />
